assumptions.description: Combine Agongo Ghana arithmetic scales, Ashanti Ghana rank dependence and Greiner Malawi relative sex contrasts as a hypothetical adult target-context scenario; no transport validity or site/lifestyle mixture is established.
Same numeric analyte/unit transfer despite fasting serum laboratory source protocols and target venous EDTA CardioChek Plus with unknown fasting; no validated assay-error bridge.
Source residence, health, pregnancy and complete-case exclusions differ from target; no unavailable flags or source exclusions are imposed on target output.
Model and requested analyses use equal row weights; original source weighting remains not_reported, so source feedback is not_computable.
Map external women/men to F/M literals; metadata biological legend is not independently verified.
Assume pF=.5, age distribution shared across sex, iid rows and no site/lifestyle clusters; age support and within-quartile shape are choices, not target eligibility.
Latent age correlations .10 BMI, .15 TC, .05 HDL are assumed modest associations; directions and magnitudes are not source-estimated.

Continuous Gaussian copula; map Spearman rS to latent r=2 sin(pi*rS/6); transfer community-pooled rural ranks within each sex with common dependence. Not raw Pearson, adjusted slope or residual correlation.
Positive lognormal margins with all finite moments; source marginal moments transfer across age span; no clipping, tail calibration or conditional-SD interpretation.
Transport Greiner rural geometric-mean F/M ratios; common within-sex log variance equates arithmetic/geometric sex ratios; combine with distinct Agongo pooled arithmetic moments.
Fixed scenario parameters; no calibrated posterior or transport uncertainty. Source CI is estimator uncertainty, not residual variation or precision weighting.
Unreported source weighting, SD convention, tie/missingness rules and quantile definitions remain unresolved; model/ddof=1/linear conventions do not certify published methods.
Source unadjusted rank and marginal components do not identify age/sex-adjusted OLS or identical-design lipid residual Pearson correlation; requested effects are induced by the whole model.

Do not replace rank by Pearson, geometric by arithmetic or unresolved log coefficients by raw coefficients. Model derivations assume stated families; mmol/L delivery and request factor38.67 define analysis units only.

output.derivation: Task output contract and identifier formatting, no evidence-dependent effect.

female_probability.derivation: Assumption-only balanced hypothetical sex composition, not source or target sex frequency.

age.derivation: Interior knots average rural male/female source Q1, median and Q3; this is not the quantile of a mixture. Endpoints18/90 and interpolation assumed.

bmi.derivation: Direct arithmetic sex-specific mean/SD components; generator computes v=log1p((sd/mean)^2), mu=log(mean)-v/2.

lipids.derivation: F/M ratios divide selected source geometric means. Generator subtracts between-sex variance from source pooled variance, then chooses common log variance to preserve chosen pooled mean/SD.

copula.derivation: Rural unadjusted source Spearman triplet maps to latent Gaussian correlations by 2 sin(pi*rS/6). Age latent entries are assumed, not source estimates.
